cloud.title: Cloud account
cloud.signedOut: Sign in with your GitHub account.
cloud.unavailable: Cannot check sign-in. Check your connection and try again.
cloud.logoutError: Could not confirm sign-out. Connect to the internet and try again.
cloud.localNotice: The profiles below are stored on this device. Cloud history sync is not available yet. Signing out does not delete local profiles.
cloud.separateProfiles: Cloud profiles open on any device after sign-in. Profiles below this card are stored on this device.
cloud.openProfileError: Could not open the cloud profile. Try again.
cloud.syncConflict: Two devices edited the same data. Changes are saved on this device.
cloud.reauthenticate: Sign in again to open this cloud profile.
cloud.localRestoreOnly: You can restore a backup into a separate local profile.
cloud.storageBody: Entries in this profile are saved in your browser and synced through Cloudflare. Sign in with the same GitHub account to open them on another device.
cloud.storageRisk: Offline changes stay on this device until sync completes. Wait for the Synced status before clearing your browser data.
cloud.aboutBody: Lenta is a personal journal with GitHub sign-in for cloud profiles.

profiles.title: Who are you?
profiles.subtitle: Profiles are fully separate: each has its own database.
profiles.pinDisclaimer: A PIN keeps someone from opening the wrong profile on a shared device. It is not encryption: the data on disk stays unencrypted.
profiles.deleteWarning: Every record in this profile will be erased for good. Download a backup first.
profiles.deleteConfirmWord: Type the profile name to confirm

onboarding.languageSubtitle: You can change it any time.
onboarding.profileSubtitle: Used to calculate your targets. Nothing is sent anywhere.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.rateHint: A calm rate is up to 0.5 kg per week. Faster is harder to hold.
onboarding.activitySubtitle: Pick whichever is closest to a normal week.
onboarding.activity_1.9: Very high, physical work or two sessions a day
onboarding.weightSubtitle: The first point on the chart. Weigh yourself in the morning, before eating.
onboarding.bodyFat: Body fat percentage, if you know it
onboarding.bodyFatHint: With it, targets use the Katch-McArdle formula, which is more accurate.
onboarding.storageBody: Everything you record stays in this browser, on this device. There is no server, no account, and nobody but you has access.
onboarding.storageRisk: The flip side: a browser may clear its storage. Safari on iOS deletes data for sites unused for 7 days — except apps added to the home screen.
onboarding.addToHomeIos: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
onboarding.addToHomeDesktop: The install icon in the browser address bar
onboarding.persistFailed: The browser did not grant persistent storage. Backups matter even more now.
onboarding.backupPromise: Once a week the app will remind you to download a backup. One button, one file.
onboarding.calcExplain: A basal rate of {{bmr}} kcal by the {{formula}} formula, multiplied by an activity factor of {{activity}}, gives {{tdee}} kcal of daily expenditure. A rate of {{rate}} kg per week is {{delta}} kcal a day.
onboarding.calcFootnote: 7700 kcal per kilogram is a common estimate, not an exact constant.
onboarding.calcEditable: Every number can be changed right now and at any point later.
onboarding.warnBelowBmr: The result is {{kcal}} kcal — below your basal rate ({{bmr}} kcal). That deficit is hard to hold and hits how you feel.
onboarding.warnBelowFloor: The result is {{kcal}} kcal — below the sensible floor of {{floor}} kcal.
onboarding.warnFastRate: A rate of {{rate}} kg a week is fast for your weight.
onboarding.finishBody: The easiest first record is the plus button at the bottom of the screen.
onboarding.confirmPersonal: I checked my name, sex, birth date and height

food.title: Food
food.frequentEmpty: The foods you use most will show up here. For now, find the first one through search.
food.searchOnlineHint: The query goes to Open Food Facts and USDA. Anything found is saved locally.
food.searchNoMatch: No matching foods. Try another name or create a food manually.
food.createFoodMinimal: A name and calories are enough. The rest whenever you feel like it.
food.barcodeHint: Point the camera at the barcode on the package
food.barcodeNotFound: That barcode is not in the references. Create the food by hand — it takes a minute.
food.barcodeNoCamera: The camera is unavailable. You can type the barcode digits instead.
food.copyDayHint: Every record from the chosen day lands in the current one.
food.recipeYieldHint: Weigh the pot after cooking. This is what separates a correct calculation from a rough one.
food.fastingAuto: The window is detected automatically: from the first record of the day to the last.
food.alcoholKcalNote: Alcohol adds {{kcal}} kcal to the diary.
food.indexProcessingValue: {{value}}% of mass heavily processed · {{points}} of {{weight}} points
food.indexNoNova: No processing data, so that component's weight is spread across the rest.
food.planPool: What you are willing to eat this week
food.planApplyDay: Write this day into the diary
food.planEmptyPool: Mark the dishes and recipes to build the menu from.
food.planOk: The plan meets calories and protein.
food.planOff: The plan did not converge: the pool needs more variety.
food.weekToDateHint: From the start of the week through the selected date. Unlogged days remain part of the period.

gym.planBounds: Select a date. Use 1–50 sets, a whole-number rep range from 1 to 1,000, and a weight from 0 to 1,500 kg (3,306.93 lb). The upper rep limit must be at least the lower limit.
gym.cardioBounds: Enter a duration greater than zero and no longer than 24 hours; an optional distance up to 1,000 km (621.37 mi); and an optional whole-number heart rate from 20 to 250.
gym.setBounds: Weight must be between 0 and 1,500 kg (3,306.93 lb); reps a whole number from 0 to 1,000; RPE from 1 to 10 or blank. Correct the highlighted fields before completing the set.
gym.title: Gym
gym.plateNearest: Cannot load exactly. Nearest weight is {{kg}} {{unit}}
gym.unfinishedBody: The workout from {{date}} was left open.

progressionHint.repeat: Last time: {{prev}}. Repeat the same weight
progressionHint.deload: The weight has not moved for three sessions. You can drop to {{weight}} {{unit}} for one session

gym.swipeToDelete: Swipe the card left to delete
gym.offPlanTitle: You added exercises beyond the routine
gym.offPlanBody: Keep them in this workout only, or add them to the routine for good?
gym.routineResetHint: Your edits will be lost. The undo bar brings them back.
gym.routineBounds: Keep at least one day. Use 1–50 sets, 1–1000 reps (maximum no lower than minimum), and 0–3600 seconds of rest.

body.title: Body
body.weightNoise: Daily weight swings by 1–2 kg from water alone. Watch the trend line, not the dots.
body.stepsManual: Entered by hand: a browser cannot count steps in the background.
body.stepsInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200,000 steps.

habits.title: Habits
habits.name: Name
habits.freezeExplain: A freeze is earned for every 7 days in a row and automatically covers one miss.
habits.retroHint: Yesterday can be marked within 48 hours.
habits.retroExpired: More than 48 hours have passed — use the habit history instead.
habits.relapseHint: The streak starts over. Your best result and total days are kept.
habits.afterRelapse: Streak started over. Best result: {{best}} days
habits.quitExplain: A missed day does not reset the streak: only a recorded relapse does.

game.title: Progress
game.disabledNotice: Game layer is off in settings.

reasons.weekStreak: A week without breaking the streak

progress.title: Progress
progress.comparisonNote: These are descriptive observations, not conclusions about causes.
progress.comparisonNotEnough: Not enough observations yet. A comparison appears once each group has at least 10 days.

comparison.sleepVsKcal: On days with less than 6 hours of sleep, average calories were {{diff}} kcal relative to other days
comparison.workoutVsKcal: On days with a workout, average calories were {{diff}} kcal relative to days without one
comparison.stressVsIndex: On high-stress days, the nutrition index was {{diff}} points relative to other days
comparison.weekdayVsKcal: On weekends, average calories were {{diff}} kcal relative to weekdays
comparison.sleepVsHabits: On days with less than 6 hours of sleep, habit completion was {{diff}} percentage points relative to other days

progress.noData: No data for this chart yet
progress.interpolationHint: Dots show recorded weight. Dashed sections estimate the trend between missing entries.
progress.onePoint: {{date}}: {{value}}. One entry so far — add another to see a chart.
progress.habitScopeHint: Current build habits, using their current schedules. Schedule-change history was not recorded; quit habits are shown separately in Body.

settings.storageUnavailable: The browser could not report storage status. Keep a downloaded backup of your data.
settings.title: Settings
settings.recalcOffer: Your weight has changed. Update the target from {{from}} to {{to}} kcal?
settings.gamificationHint: XP, levels, achievements and streaks. Turning it off removes the layer entirely.
settings.addFoodTabsHint: Put the one you use most first.
settings.dataWhatBody: Every record lives in this browser's IndexedDB, tied to the profile. There is no server: nothing leaves the device until you press Download backup or connect Google Drive yourself.
settings.deleteAllWarning: This erases the whole profile database: food, training, measurements, habits. It cannot be undone.
settings.gdriveHint: This is backup, not real-time sync between devices.
settings.gdriveSetupNeeded: A Client ID from Google Cloud Console is required. Step-by-step instructions are in docs/google-drive-setup.md.
settings.gdriveOptional: Connecting Drive is optional: exporting the file by hand is a complete backup method.
settings.aboutBody: Lenta is a personal app for two. No server, no ads, no subscriptions, no analytics.
settings.aboutMedical: This app is not a medical device, does not diagnose, and does not replace a doctor or a dietitian.
settings.attributionOff: Product data — Open Food Facts, ODbL licence.
settings.attributionUsda: Built-in food set — USDA FoodData Central, public domain.
settings.deviceStorageHint: Data stays in this browser on this device. Clearing browser data can remove your journal. Download backups regularly; use export and import to move to another device.

backup.reminderBody: The last backup was {{days}} days ago. The data lives only in this browser: if it clears storage, there is nowhere to restore from.
backup.reminderNever: There has been no backup yet. The data lives only in this browser.
backup.modeReplaceHint: Current profile data will be erased and replaced with the file contents.
backup.modeMergeHint: Records from the file are added. On a clash the newer version wins.
backup.errFormat: This is not a Lenta backup file.
backup.errVersion: The file was made by another version of the app (v{{version}}). Update the app and try again.
backup.errParse: The file is damaged and cannot be read.
backup.credentialsOmitted: API keys are excluded. Reconnect your provider after restoring.

ai.title: AI
ai.masterHint: Off by default. The app works fully without AI: every feature has a replacement, except recognising food from a photo.
ai.apiKeyHint: The key is stored in this profile's database on your device. It goes nowhere except the chosen provider's API.
ai.limitReached: The monthly limit is used up. AI features are off until next month.
ai.draftNotice: This is a draft. Check and correct it before saving.
ai.photoDisclaimer: The estimate is approximate. Check the weights.
ai.photoAccuracy: Calorie estimates from a photo carry substantial error: fine for a rough log, not for precise tracking.
ai.textParseLocal: Parsed locally, without network and without AI.
ai.textParseNotFound: “{{query}}” was not found. Refine the name or create the food.
ai.estimateCost: Call cost depends on the provider's plan. Check the terms before connecting.

errors.cameraDenied: Camera access was not granted. Allow it in browser settings or type the barcode digits.
errors.networkOffline: No network. Online search returns when the connection does.
errors.networkFailed: The reference did not answer. Try later or create the food by hand.
errors.saveFailed: Could not save. Your draft is still here — please retry.
errors.importFailed: The file could not be loaded
errors.aiFailed: The provider did not answer. The draft can be filled by hand.

update.hint: The update applies after a reload. An unfinished workout is preserved.
